standard_prerequisites.name: Flat base change for cohomology of quasi-compact opens: for f : X to Y with the square cartesian and A to B flat, Gamma(f^{-1}(V), O_X) = Gamma(V, O_Y) tensor_A B for V quasi-compact open (Cohomology of Schemes chapter, Lemma coherent-lemma-flat-base-change-cohomology, canonical tag 02KH)
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the single-open base case of the equality, which the colimit assembly extends to E.

core_obligations: Write E = intersection over i in I of V_i with V_i quasi-compact open in Y. Refinement: as in the carried lead-in to equation-sections-of-intersection, by adding finite intersections the family may and does be assumed directed, so for i, j in I there is k in I with V_k inside V_i intersect V_j; cartesian squares preserve intersections, so f^{-1}(E) = intersection of the f^{-1}(V_i) in X. Sections step: by the carried equation, Gamma(f^{-1}(E), O_X) = colim Gamma(f^{-1}(V_i), O_X) and Gamma(E, O_Y) = colim Gamma(V_i, O_Y). Base case: for each i, the cartesian square restricts to V_i, and coherent-lemma-flat-base-change-cohomology with A to B flat gives Gamma(f^{-1}(V_i), O_X) = Gamma(V_i, O_Y) tensor_A B. Assembly: colimits commute with tensoring by B, so Gamma(f^{-1}(E), O_X) = Gamma(E, O_Y) tensor_A B, using that Y is quasi-separated as the equation requires.
proof_roadmap: Write E as the intersection of the V_i and make the family directed by adding finite intersections; note f^{-1}(E) is the intersection of the f^{-1}(V_i) (proof lines 3299-3302).
Use the carried sections-of-intersection equation to write both sides as colimits over the directed families (proof line 3303).
Apply coherent-lemma-flat-base-change-cohomology to each V_i and assemble the colimit into the displayed equality (proof lines 3304-3305).
